Role Summary 
We are looking for a seasoned engineering leader to support the modernization of a large-scale enterprise platform within a regulated financial services environment. The role will initially focus on engineering hygiene improvements, helping reduce technical complexity, improve maintainability, and establish stronger engineering practices. Beyond the initial stabilization and clean-up phase, the individual will play a key role in shaping the target architecture and guiding a phased modernization journey. This position requires a strong combination of technical leadership, architectural thinking, stakeholder management, and hands-on engineering experience 
 
Key Responsibilities 
Engineering Excellence & Platform Improvement 
Lead engineering hygiene and code quality improvement initiatives 
Assess and reduce technical debt across the application landscape 
Define and implement improvements to:  
Engineering standards and practices 
Branching and version control strategy 
Release management processes 
Development lifecycle governance 
Quality assurance and testing practices 
Identify and prioritize quick wins that deliver immediate business and engineering value 
Modernization Strategy & Architecture 
Contribute to the definition of target architecture and modernization roadmap 
Assess application landscape, dependencies, integrations, and business-critical workflows 
Recommend modernization approaches and implementation sequencing 
Balance technical improvements with business priorities and operational constraints 
Support phased transformation planning and execution 
Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory 
Act as a trusted advisor to both technology and business stakeholders 
Facilitate architecture reviews and decision-making sessions 
Communicate technical findings in clear business language 
Challenge assumptions and provide pragmatic recommendations 
Build alignment across engineering, architecture, product, and business teams 
Technical Leadership 
Provide technical direction and governance to delivery teams 
Mentor engineers and promote engineering best practices 
Drive consistency, maintainability, and long-term sustainability 
Ensure recommendations are actionable and aligned with strategic objectives
yeu_cau:
Required Experience 
10+ years of software engineering experience 
Proven track record leading modernization or transformation initiatives for large enterprise applications 
Strong software architecture and solution design expertise 
Experience improving engineering practices within complex environments 
Demonstrated success reducing technical debt and improving platform maintainability 
Experience working within banking, financial services, fintech, insurance, or other regulated industries 
Technical Expertise 
The ideal candidate should have strong experience across multiple areas of the modern enterprise application landscape: 
Deep expertise in Java-based enterprise applications and distributed systems 
Strong understanding of modern application architectures and integration patterns 
Experience modernizing legacy platforms and reducing technical debt 
Strong database and data modelling knowledge, ideally within Oracle environments 
Experience with messaging and event-driven architectures 
Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks and API-driven architectures 
Good understanding of application security, authentication and identity management 
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerized platforms and cloud-native practices 
Experience defining engineering standards, release strategies and development governance 
Familiarity with AI-assisted software engineering tools and modern developer productivity practices is a strong advantage 
Stakeholder & Leadership Skills 
The successful candidate must be comfortable operating at both strategic and delivery levels. Key capabilities include: 
Strong executive and stakeholder communication skills 
Ability to influence technical and business decisions 
Ability to translate technical complexity into business impact 
Strong consulting mindset and problem-solving skills 
Ability to drive consensus across multiple stakeholder groups
